title: SIGMA: Symmetry-aware, Intelligent, Geometric, Multi-objective Adaptive Control for Robust, Dependable Traffic Management
abstract: arXiv:2608.18263v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traffic signal control is a complex sequential decision-making problem requiring real-time adaptation and trade-offs among throughput, delay fairness, signal stability, and emergency vehicle priority. Existing RL methods often fix objectives, ignore dynamic priority changes, and fail to generalize across geometrically similar intersections.We propose SIGMA (Symmetry-aware, Intelligent, Geometric, Multi-objective Adaptive traffic control), an RL framework enhanced with a large language model (LLM) for adaptive objective tuning and orientation-invariant learning. SIGMA converts natural-language emergency commands into priority vectors for a multi-objective actor-critic controller, avoiding manual reward engineering. translated_title: SIGMA：对称感知、智能、几何、多目标自适应控制，用于稳健、可靠的交通管理
translated_abstract: 交通信号控制是一个复杂的序列决策问题，需要实时适应并在吞吐量、延迟公平性、信号稳定性和紧急车辆优先权之间进行权衡。现有的强化学习方法通常固定目标，忽略动态优先级变化，并且难以在几何相似的交叉口之间泛化。我们提出了SIGMA（对称感知、智能、几何、多目标自适应交通控制），这是一个由大型语言模型（LLM）增强的强化学习框架，用于自适应目标调整和方向不变学习。SIGMA将自然语言紧急命令转换为多目标actor-critic控制器的优先级向量，避免了手动奖励工程。旋转增强提高了在四向交叉口的可转移性，而离线到在线学习确保了稳定的初始化和对交通变化的逐步适应。我们定义了覆盖可靠性的属性。
tldr: 本文提出了SIGMA框架，通过结合大型语言模型进行动态目标调整和旋转增强实现方向不变学习，从而在交通信号控制中实现多目标自适应和跨场景泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SIGMA, a framework that integrates large language models for dynamic objective tuning and rotational augmentation for orientation-invariant learning, enabling multi-objective adaptation and cross-scene generalization in traffic signal control.
